_comment: WS-3.1 §5.6 behavior-comparison golden. Each fixture's outcome is the CURRENT (pre-WS-3.1) verifyCognitoJwt decision for a Cognito-shaped token, which the new verifyJwt path must reproduce. Outcomes are compared, not attempt counts [SEC-10]. The two MUST-fix fixtures (no_exp, missing_sub) are the sanctioned new rejects [SEC-1]/[SEC-8]: the old path would have accepted no_exp and coerced missing_sub to ''.
_validAuthContext_comment: `scopes: "*"` was added deliberately by plan 034 lane A: the Bearer-JWT path now states the principal it always was — first-party, unscoped — instead of leaving it implicit in an absent field. `clientId` is intentionally absent here rather than null, because the middleware sets it to `undefined` and the comparison treats undefined and absent alike. If a future change makes this anything other than "*" on the first-party path, this gate is supposed to fail.
